page_title: LEC 2-0 SAL | Lecce v Salernitana 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' That's it for today, Luca Massimi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+12' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+12' Lecce take a short corner kick.

90+10' Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Massimi with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+8' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) into the top left hand corner, giving goalkeeper Guillermo Ochoa no chance!
90+7' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) is going to take the penalty!
90+7' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Lecce!
90+6' There's a break in play and referee Luca Massimi must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lecce using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+5' Joan Gonzalez (Lecce) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
90+4' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
90+4' Lecce force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+4' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90+3' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
90+3' Roberto D'Aversa (Lecce) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.

90+2' Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Lecce will have a corner.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' One of the players from Salernitana times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
87' What a big chance! Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
83' Emil Bohinen (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Massimi had an easy-decision to make.
83' Poor challenge! Emil Bohinen (Salernitana) is penalised for tripping and Luca Massimi blows his whistle.
81' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) steps up to send the ball in.
80' Paulo Sousa has decided to make a change. Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) replaces Lorenzo Pirola.
77' Paulo Sousa prepares a substitution. Mateusz Legowski is replaced by Emil Bohinen (Salernitana).
77' A substitution has been made. Antonino Gallo is replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce).
76' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) was quite harsh and Luca Massimi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul.

75' What a great touch by Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) after latching on to a precise pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and rips a shot close to the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper makes an astonishing save, knocking the ball onto the post.
73' OFF THE POST! Good play from Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) as skips past two defending players and from the edge of the box unleashes a decent strike that smashes the right post!
71' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Strefezza (Lecce) replacing Lameck Banda.
70' The referee signals a substitution. Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Nikola Krstovic.
70' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
68' Luca Massimi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Lameck Banda (Lecce).
67' Lameck Banda (Lecce) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
65' Salernitana take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to substitute Mohamed Kaba and he is replaced by Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hamza Rafia leaves the pitch and Alexis Blin (Lecce) comes on.
62' Substitution. Erik Botheim is replaced by Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana).
62' Substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) replaces Grigoris Kastanos.
61' Paulo Sousa decides to make a substitution. Lassana Coulibaly will be replaced by Agustin Martegani (Salernitana).

59' Erik Botheim (Salernitana) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
58' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Guillermo Ochoa easily deals with the threat.
56' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
53' Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
49' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) commits a rough challenge and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for an infringement.
48' The linesman points to the corner flag, Salernitana are going to take it.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Salernitana work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

44' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Wladimiro Falcone. Salernitana have been awarded a corner kick.
42' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Lameck Banda (Lecce) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
42' A clumsy foul by Lameck Banda (Lecce) and Luca Massimi blows his whistle.
39' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) is penalised for holding. Luca Massimi signals a set piece.
36' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
34' Jovane Cabral (Salernitana) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
33' What a chance that is! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
30' Luca Massimi shows a yellow card to Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) for his blatant foul.
29' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) makes a slide tackle, but referee Luca Massimi blows for a foul. Salernitana are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

28' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Wladimiro Falcone is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
27' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) commits a rough foul. Luca Massimi stops the game and makes a call.
23' A cross from Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
22' Salernitana hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
19' Lameck Banda (Lecce) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom left corner, but Guillermo Ochoa keeps it out with an amazing save.
17' Matteo Lovato (Salernitana) has tested the patience of referee Luca Massimi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
17' Matteo Lovato (Salernitana) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
14' Lameck Banda (Lecce) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
11' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
10' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana).
9' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Valentin Gendrey and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom left corner from close range. 1:0.
4' Lecce are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
3' This shall not pass! Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Lecce will kick the game off.
Luca Massimi is the one to supervise the game today.
